section_summary.extract_value: This 'Results for men' section reports factor-analytic results for the BAS in men, finding a one-factor solution (eigenvalue = 4.98, 38.3% variance) and good internal consistency (Cronbach's α = .85). It notes that correlations (including BMI) for women are reported in Table 2 and qualitatively states that there was no association between male body appreciation and BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: 'The results of a factor analysis ... revealed a one-factor solution with an eigenvalue of 4.98 (38.3% of the variance explained).'; 'Cronbach's \alpha for all 13 items of the BAS for men revealed that the internal consistency was good (\alpha = .85).'; 'BAS showed ... a moderate positive association with BMI ...' (women, Table 2); 'There was, however, no association between male body appreciation and BMI.'
